note: Golden vectors for --expect-region-contains against an h3_polygon_set region. Generated with the reference H3 C library v4.5.0 (Python binding). Semantics: the region is the filled union of the cells; a point is inside iff some cell C has latLngToCell(point, res(C)) == C at C's own resolution. Malformed sets (empty, or any index that is not a valid H3 v4 cell) FAIL closed. cell_ids are hex strings (64-bit; exceeds JS 2^53). point is [lat, lon] in degrees; point_f64_bits_hex is the exact IEEE-754 bit pattern of each (use it, so a boundary point survives parsing bit-exactly). Never edit an expect value to make a test pass: regenerate from the reference library.
